sentences.en: Sami was going into the sophomore year of high school.
sentences.zh: 萨米即将进入高中二年级。

sentences.en: Sami admitted to me that he was dating a sophomore.
sentences.zh: 萨米向我承认他正在和一个大二女生交往。

sentences.en: Sami was the talk of the sophomore grade.
sentences.zh: 萨米成了全班的大话题。
